notes.connections: Lines connect recorded stops and do not represent actual roads or flight paths. Added Kiyama connections have unspecified direction; Otsu and Kyoto are explicitly linked in both directions.
notes.returns: Departure and return links inferred from the original >/< notation are retained as city connections.
notes.approximate: Nakagami, Iriomote, Oroqen and the Aral Sea use regional reference points.
notes.coordinates: City-centre reference points, checked against GeoNames where a matching city record is available. Small localities and regions use approximate reference points.
notes.administrativeAreas: Administrative areas filled from GeoNames, with local province/municipality equivalents. Singapore is displayed as Singapore, Singapore. The Aral Sea remains a regional reference.
notes.baseCities: Initially inferred from the relocation headings and the Tacoma base entry in the supplied place list.
notes.countrySelection: Only visited countries are selectable. Taiwan city records and polygons are grouped under China.
notes.administrativeStatistics: First-level units containing recorded places; repeated places do not increase the visited-unit count. Unspecified regional stops and Singapore are not inferred into additional units.
notes.turkeyUpdates: Cappadocia replaced by recorded cities. Updated chains: Ankara–Kaman–Kırıkkale–Boğazkale–Ankara; Antalya–Kayseri–Avanos–Çavuşin–Göreme–Nevşehir–Istanbul; Kars–Iğdır–Doğubayazıt; Bergama–Akçay–Troy–Çanakkale–Gelibolu–Tekirdağ–Istanbul. Gerede linked to Ankara and Safranbolu without inferring direction.
